verdict.rationale: a-Shell has its own documented ways to move files out of the app. You can move files to other apps, use the Get File Shortcuts action, and compress files with zip. User files stay in their native formats, and theme config is plain JSON in the Windows Terminal scheme format. Missing for 10: a documented one-step export of all app data (command history, settings, bookmarks), an explicit guarantee that everything is exportable in open formats, and independent hands-on corroboration of a complete exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Create directories, move files, compress them, uncompress them, edit them, run python, lua or Tex on your files, move them to other apps.
`Put File` and `Get File` are used to transfer files to and from a-Shell.
You can send the result in a third app.
Edit the JSON file in Files or a text editor. It uses the Windows Terminal color scheme format
